name: password-input
summary: A password, hidden as it is typed, with a button beside it that shows and hides it: label, hint and error, with read-only, disabled and invalid, each hidden and shown.

notCovered.name: the dots of a hidden password
notCovered.why: A hidden password draws each character as a dot, and the check reads a field's value as words only while the field shows text, so the dots' contrast is never measured. They are drawn in the field's text colour, the same colour a shown password's words take, which every light reads.

notCovered.name: the touch target
notCovered.why: Under a coarse pointer UI SDK lays an empty box 2.75rem each way around the show button, which is 2.25rem square, so a tap near it reaches it. The box draws nothing, so no light reads its size, and the part leaves it as UI SDK sets it.

notCovered.name: Caps Lock
notCovered.why: UI SDK marks the field with data-capslock while Caps Lock is on and the field has focus; this part gives that mark no look and the showroom shows no warning, so nothing a person sees changes with it, and the keyboard rows never press Caps Lock.

notCovered.name: the form
notCovered.why: UI SDK hides a shown password when its form submits or resets and when the page is hidden; no field here sits in a form, and the page is never hidden while the check reads it, so only the show button shows and hides what is typed.
